notlar: ImageNetV2 intervals are image-bootstrap intervals, not between-pair intervals; drawn open as descriptive.
Ratio-scale sensitivities are not drawn (different unit), as in the council figure.
Row labels: C10 = CIFAR-10, C100 = CIFAR-100, IN-V2 = ImageNetV2, Liu scr. = the Liu scratch-row pair.
kararlar: Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the A-bar row reads 'IN-V2 Ā(σ, IN)' and the bottom x label 'A(ρ)', in the function notation of cells_interaction, because super- and subscripts print under the 8 pt floor and a bare 'A' named two different contrasts in two figures; the caption maps them to A-bar^sigma_IN and A^rho.

Karar (duzeltme turu 2): the reference lines (+-delta, H1 size) already stop at the last log-scale row (vlines from -0.6 to idx[-1] + 0.5); the verifier's finding holds for the council figure, not for this one, so nothing changes there.
Karar: row labels are shortened (C10, C100, IN-V2) so the row-label column stays at 24 mm (plan section 6: at most 25 mm) and the value axis keeps over 0.45 of the width.
Karar: the 90% interval is a thin bar (an area) and the 95% interval the style's error line, so no line weight is written in the script.
Karar: the +-delta band uses the style's vurgu_kutusu tone (orange family, as in cells_interaction), because the grey band tone equals the plot area.
